Kerala Govt. Faces Criticism Over Vande Mataram Singing Directive

The Kerala government is facing criticism following a directive regarding the singing of Vande Mataram. While some reports indicate a directive was issued for the full rendition on Independence Day, government ministers have clarified that only the first two couplets will be sung at state events. Congress MP Rajmohan Unnithan stated that the full Vande Mataram would not be sung "in this lifetime," even under duress. Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala claimed ignorance of any specific directive, while Health Minister K. Muraleedharan confirmed the two-couplet policy.
